properties.name: Oil spill 1 - Unity-Heglig export pipeline rupture
properties.evidence: Rupture on or about 24 Aug 2019, ~40 km north of Rubkona; ~12,500 bbl (2 million L) over ~10,000 m2, measured from satellite imagery and an on-site visit
properties.date_basis: rupture date from satellite imagery and site visit; repair documented, clean-up not
properties.source: Sign of Hope, "Causing a Black Tide of Oil" (25 Feb 2020) and UN written statement 2020; https://www.hoffnungszeichen.de/sites/default/files/documents/causing_a_black_tide_of_oil_-_south_sudans_polluting_pipeline_-_sign_of_hope.pdf

properties.name: Oil spill 1 - Unity-Heglig export pipeline rupture

properties.name: River sampling report: Nahm and Abuk rivers around Bentiu and Rotriak (Rubkona)
properties.evidence: Kuer (Kenyatta University) reports lead up to 18 ug/L (about twice the WHO guideline) and hydrocarbons more than five times recommended limits; sampling dates not given in coverage
properties.date_basis: sampling dates not published; shown from the 2024-25 coverage
properties.coord_quality: approximate: OCHA COD settlements gazetteer (Rotriak, Village, Rubkona)

properties.name: Flooded oil wells report: Unity State
properties.evidence: Extreme 2021 floods never fully receded; PAX (2023) found 159 Block 2 wells (~41%) submerged; New Lines/Placemark (early 2026) found 50+ of ~400 Unity wells still underwater. See oil_wells_flooding_monthly_2018_2025.csv for a satellite check at each mapped well
properties.date_basis: floods from Jul 2021 never fully receded (PAX 2023; New Lines/Placemark 2026)
properties.coord_quality: approximate: Unity oil field (GEM GOGET point); report covers Block 2 wells
